caption: The drawing shows a full-length depiction of a person in a historical military uniform, rendered in watercolor and ink. The uniform consists of a blue double-breasted coat adorned with gold buttons and gold epaulettes with thick fringes, worn over a high-collared shirt. The coat has beige cuffs, a beige standing collar, and shoulder decorations. The individual is wearing beige trousers that extend below the coat and high black boots. The drawing also includes a detail of the back of the blue coat, showing two gold stars near the tails and buttons along the back. To the upper right, there is a depiction of a black bicorne hat decorated with gold trim and a central gold emblem. The background is plain and off-white. The rendering style is detailed, emphasizing the colors and features of the clothing.
title: Uniform
